A Biomass Plant Technician does more than watch instruments or record data. The occupation centers on boilers and fuel-feed systems: monitoring combustion conditions, adjusting operating parameters, handling blockages and slagging, converting crop residues into electricity, and maintaining safe and stable generation. It suits dependable, steady, and disciplined people.
